query:
UPDATE oauth_accounts
            SET user_id = $2,
                provider_user_id = $3,
                provider_tenant_id = $4,
                provider_object_id = $5,
                email = $6,
                email_verified = $7,
                access_token = $8,
                refresh_token = $9,
                id_token = $10,
                token_type = $11,
                scope = $12,
                expires_at = $13,
                last_login_at = now(),
                updated_at = now()
          WHERE id = $1
